findings.highlight: did they all come to afterward?
findings.evidenceJa: みんなすぐに気が付いたのか
findings.governingReading: すぐに気が付いたのか asks whether all the collapsed students quickly regained consciousness.
findings.explanation: The immediate-recovery question loses its speed condition.

findings.highlight: the only that does not realize this situation.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分だけ気が付いていない
findings.governingReading: 自分だけ気が付いていない describes Rin alone failing to notice the surrounding reaction.
findings.explanation: The person-only clause loses its required head.

findings.governingReading: 集まり易すぎる describes being too easy to gather/accumulate, leaving the phenomenon’s exact meaning unspoken.
findings.explanation: Excessive ease of gathering becomes excessive quantity collected.
